persons.name: Aśvinīkumāra
persons.evidence: viprottama śrī aśvinīkumāraḥ || (!) nabhasya māhātmya likhaṃ

date.as_written: nepālavarṣe śaśikhabhracandre māse śuce kṛṣṇa śubhe dinesmin tithau ca kāma śaśidevaṛkṣe vyāghāṭa (!) yoge ravisūnuvāre

notes: Year given in bhūtasaṃkhyā: śaśi (1) khabhra (0, 0) candre (1) = NS 1001. Kāmatithi corresponds to Trayodaśī (13).
